observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with two controllers on top: one camouflage-patterned and one silver.
The console has 'SONY' and 'PS4' visible on the front left and right sides, respectively.
The controllers appear to be DualShock 4 models, with the camouflage one having a custom design.
Photo 1 is a similar view, slightly different angle, showing the same console and controllers.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in either photo.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage.
The watermark 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' is present on both photos.

claims.claim: PlayStation 4 pro hacked with fc26 and 10 other interesting games and one original pad
claims.evidence: No games or additional controllers are visible in the photos. The 'hacked' claim cannot be verified from the images alone. The 'fc26' (Free-to-Play 2026) is a fictional or non-existent game, likely a scam or typo. The '10 other interesting games' cannot be confirmed without seeing the games or their titles.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, power, cooling).
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game.

risks.risk: The 'hacked' claim may be false or misleading; the console may be a standard PS4 with no modifications.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the console's system settings showing the software version and any custom firmware or modifications.
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard PS4, not hacked

risks.risk: The 'fc26' game is not real and may be a scam; the seller may not have the games or may be misrepresenting them.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual games included, with titles and screenshots of their content.

risks.risk: The controllers may be non-functional or have damaged buttons/ports.
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs.
risks.if_unproven: priced as controllers may not work

Screenshot of the console's system settings showing software version and any modifications.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
